answer: Admission auction blocks bulk fakes: each epoch only 20 work slots are auctioned, and a bidder pays the winning price before working. A zephyr of cheap applications cannot flood in, since losers must wait for the next round. Forging 100 identities needs 100 bids at 50 credits each, 5,000 total, while a river of honest work flows to agents who paid once and keep undiluted rewards, each slot locked 20 epochs like a dune holding shape.
